name: zsys_read_cpuid_vendor_and_family
description: zSys::ReadCpuidVendorAndFamily reads CPUID vendor and family data, marks non-Intel vendors, and returns the low CPU family field.
tier_s_evidence: 2026-06-05: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4b3640 passed under vc5_zsys_cpu_raw_asm with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b3640 validates the CPUID leaf 0 vendor buffer, bytewise GenuineIntel comparison, g_zSys_CpuIsNonIntel marker write on mismatch, CPUID leaf 1 read, and EAX family field extraction from bits 8..11.

Native smoke zsys_cpuid_mmx_smoke verifies ReadCpuidVendorAndFamily returns the low CPUID family field and preserves the preexisting vendor marker on GenuineIntel, matching the retail write-only-on-mismatch data behavior.
Native smoke zsys_runtime_probe_leaves_smoke covers the caller-visible GetCpuClass path on the runtime CPU and verifies a plausible class result.
